## Description {#details}

<p>A base class holding non-template-dependant functionality of the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/acceltable">AccelTable</a> class.</p>


<p>Clients should not use this class directly but rather instantiate <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/acceltable">AccelTable</a> with a type derived from <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/acceltabledata">AccelTableData</a>.</p>
